translationRepairs: That same day Xiao Han, the Khitan-appointed governor of Bian, brought Duke of Xun Li Congyi to the Eastern Capital and asked him to take charge of the Southern Court's military and civil affairs.
That same day Xiao Han, the Khitan-appointed governor of Bian, brought Li Congyi, Duke of Xun, to the Eastern Capital and asked him to take charge of the Southern Court's military and civil affairs.
The appositive form clearly separates Li Congyi's personal name from his title 郇國公 and reads naturally in English.
Hanlin academician and vice minister of rites Bian Guangfan was appointed director of the court for the imperial clan.
Hanlin academician and vice minister of rites Bian Guangfan was appointed director of the Court of the Imperial Insignia.
衛尉卿 heads the Court of the Imperial Insignia; the existing wording incorrectly identifies the separate court for the imperial clan.
